title: Nonhomogeneous relational time: structural and kinematic physics from finite relational event networks
description: Pre-synthesis reproducibility archive for the LQTA-D Article 3 branch. The archive develops nonhomogeneous relational time from CAL scale comparisons, recovers local rates only in the integrable sector, identifies irreducible cycle-supported temporal memory, derives provenance-conditioned continuity and support-change defect laws, and closes with a no-go against a unique autonomous CAL generator. Claims are finite and structural/kinematic; no spacetime metric, Lorentz symmetry, energy, entropy, Hamiltonian, or autonomous dynamics is claimed.
